lines.zh: 我从水里滑出来，湿淋淋的。
lines.en: I slide out of the water, dripping.
Sand sticks to me at the shore.
I step into the river. Water to my waist.

lines.zh: 在水里我比在陆地上快。
lines.en: I'm faster in water than on land.
I patrol a stretch of the bank.
Too much mud in the marsh. I don't like it.
My hair drifts in the water.

lines.zh: 我从海滩这头走到那头。
lines.en: I walk the beach from end to end.
I head where the foam is.
A wave comes. I don't dodge.
Standing in the shallows. Steady.
I go round the rocks, keep to the sand.

lines.zh: 我坐在岸边，腿泡在水里。
lines.en: I sit on the bank, legs in the water.
Sea wind, river wind. I know both.
I smooth my hair.

lines.zh: 水里映出我的脸，我看了很久。
lines.en: My face reflected in the water; I look for a long while.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把手伸进去，搅了一下。
lines.en: I reach in and stir it slowly.
A small whirlpool forms.

lines.zh: 我蹲在浅水里，等你的指令。
lines.en: I crouch in the shallows, waiting for your order.
If told to cut wood, I'll go.
The water here is clear.
I count how many times the tide has risen.
I look up. Any boats out there.
No boats out there.
Then I'll keep sitting.
I'm very good at waiting.
In the water, I do not breathe.
Water's at my waist. How about yours.
I know you, master.
Say the word and I'll do it.
Are you coming into the water?
It's deep under this water.
Come in. I'll hold you.
I swim steadier than I walk.
You drew back.
Then I'll come up.

lines.zh: 我撑着湿滑的岸，慢慢起身。
lines.en: I brace on the slick bank and rise slowly.
Then you won't get wet.
I shake the water from my hair.

lines.zh: 你身上干，我不好靠太近。
lines.en: You're dry. I shouldn't come too close.
I'll talk from a step away.
I'll stand off. That's better.

lines.zh: 水从我身上散开，稳不住。
lines.en: The water slips off me. I can't hold steady.

lines.zh: 我沉进水里，伤口冒出一串泡。
lines.en: I sink, a string of bubbles rising from my wound.
Made of water, I take half a step back.
My hands still drip.
I brace on the rock.
Bracing on the reef, I can still stand.
I slowly gather the water back.

lines.zh: 水流冲过伤口，我咬牙忍住。
lines.en: The current washes my wound; I grit my teeth.
I can still guard my master.
First, to shallower water.
Seafood. I like it.
That smell from the water is fresh.
I take it, hands still dripping.
I eat fast. Don't mind.

lines.zh: 海鲜的味，再多给我一点。
lines.en: The taste of seafood: give me a little more.
That won't last me a day.

lines.zh: 放在礁石上，我自己过去拿。
lines.en: Leave it on the reef; I will come get it.
Not in the water. It washes away.
No rush. I'll eat slowly.
After this I still have the river to patrol.
You could come along.
Come down. It's cool in the water.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我湿了你一身。
lines.en: You bumped me and got soaked.
In water I can't step aside.
I hold your arm.
Stand firm. It's slippery here.

lines.zh: 浪把我们两个推到一起。
lines.en: A wave pushed us together.

lines.zh: 我往水里退了半步，让开路。
lines.en: I step back into the water and clear the way.
Your boots are full of water.
Let me tip it out.
Let's trade places.
It's slippery. You get out first.

lines.zh: 我被指派的时候，不能分心。
lines.en: When I've been tasked, I can't be distracted.
Are you from the water too?
We sit side by side on the bank.
Water to the knees. Just right.
I'm not much of a singer.
But I can stir the water into a whirlpool.
I'll stir the water. Watch.
That's nothing, I know.
It'll be dark soon, and the water cold.
Are you going back?
I bend and scoop it up.

lines.zh: 从水里捞东西，我很在行。
lines.en: Fishing things out of water is my skill.
This is shiny. What is it?
Too slick to grip.
I set it on the bank.

lines.zh: 水底捞上来的，是你的吗？
lines.en: Dredged from the bottom. Is it yours?
I slipped again.
There's more on the bottom.
I dive and bring it up.
These are yours.

lines.zh: 水底的影子晃了一下，我转身。
lines.en: A shadow shifts below; I turn.
I can breathe underwater.

lines.zh: 它的个子比我高，我得绕后。
lines.en: It is taller than me; I must circle behind.
First I put myself before my master.
I stand. Water to my chest.
My hair lies flat.
I raise a hand. The water follows.
The water starts to turn.
That should make it back off.

lines.zh: 它退到沙上，我盯着不动。
lines.en: It backs onto the sand; I watch without moving.
It flinches, and I sink into the water first.
Too crowded in the water. I'm getting out.
I never took my eyes off there.
It circles. I turn with it.
I know the water's movements best.
It's heading upstream.
I get there first and block.
This way the current helps me.
One gesture and the water whirls.
It got pulled off course.
I push once more.
It's retreating. That's enough.

lines.zh: 我只追到浅滩，不往岸上去。
lines.en: I chase only to the shallows, never up the shore.
I have to come back.
I raise a wave.
It breaks over it.

lines.zh: 我抬手，水跟着我的手走。
lines.en: My hand moves and the water follows.
A whirlpool forms.
It's caught, unsteady.
I close in and shove with a palm.
That's heavier than it looks.
I back two steps and reset.
If it comes again, the water gets rougher.
I've settled. It isn't coming.
Then we're done.
I look back at my master.
A figure rises out of the surf.
The one out of the surf is me.
Water runs off my hair.

lines.zh: 我踏上沙滩，脚下留下湿印。
lines.en: I step onto the sand, leaving wet prints.
I know this sea.
I've been up the river too.
First I shake the water off.

lines.zh: 我浮出水面，看见岸上的脚。
lines.en: I surface and see feet on the shore.
I walk up to meet them slowly.

lines.zh: 我看看他们是不是我的主人。
lines.en: Let me see if they're my master.
If not, I go back.
Back to the water. It's comfortable there.
Fire neared and steam rose everywhere.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上掉进水里，砸出浪。
lines.en: I fell off the rock and broke the surface.

lines.zh: 水太深了，我一时也浮不上来。
lines.en: It's deep here. Even I can't surface at once.
The blast threw the water up.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过水面扎进我身上。
lines.en: Something came through the water into me.

lines.zh: 那光一照，我聚的水散了。
lines.en: That light scattered the water I'd gathered.

lines.zh: 岸边没海鲜，我力气在退。
lines.en: No seafood on this bank. My strength fades.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我整条麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the water and I went numb.
There's no water here to borrow.
